title: Why this Dividend Stock Reset Makes it a Must Buy
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: Joseph Hogue hosts 'Mr. SCHD' Mark Roussin to dissect SCHD's annual reconstitution: 22 stocks removed (including Cisco CSCO and AbbVie ABBV) and 25 added (including UnitedHealth UNH, Qualcomm QCOM, and Macy's), leaving consumer staples, healthcare and energy as the top sectors. Mark explains the rules-based methodology (10 consecutive dividend years, quality screens on cash-flow-to-debt, ROE, yield and dividend growth; 4% single-stock cap; no human stock-picking) and praises its buy-the-dip construction. His two favorite additions: UNH - 'I would buy this outside of SCHD as well,' beaten down with valuation appeal though risky - and QCOM, left behind by chip peers and potentially giving SCHD 'some life' as Cisco's tech-sector replacement. ABBV is his longest-held individual position; he regrets its removal but still likes the pipeline. He also owns VIG and DGRO for tech-heavier dividend growth. The back half is portfolio philosophy: balance over naive diversification (10% single-stock cap, ~50 total positions), comfort with S&P 500 tech concentration (he wants NVDA/AVGO/AMZN/MSFT exposure), SCHD as the 'greatest complement' to growth-heavy portfolios, and his rules - quality before valuation, never buy blind dips, mind ETF expense ratios. He holds speculative names (IREN, SOFI) but sizes them small. Calls: SCHD, UNH, QCOM BUY; ABBV, VIG, DGRO, VOO HOLD; AVGO, CSCO, IREN, SOFI UNCERTAIN.
